option_relations.rationale: Polymorphous light eruption is a photodermatosis, but the pustular variant is not directly related to Demodex folliculitis.
Acne aestivalis is a form of acne triggered by sun exposure, but it is not directly related to Demodex folliculitis.
Actinic folliculitis is a type of folliculitis caused by sun exposure, but it is not directly related to Demodex folliculitis.
Eosinophilic folliculitis is a type of folliculitis characterized by eosinophilic infiltration, but it is not directly related to Demodex folliculitis.
